# services/reservations — Lean Context (see llms-full.txt for implementation details)

Fastify + Prisma reservation management service. Port 3004.

## Entity Hierarchy

VenueGroup (1) --> Venue (many) --> Table, Reservation, Guest, ReservationHold, FloorPlan

## Key Types (from @mbe/types)

type ReservationStatus = "PENDING" | "CONFIRMED" | "CANCELLED" | "COMPLETED" | "NO_SHOW"
type TableStatus = "AVAILABLE" | "OCCUPIED" | "DIRTY" | "READY"
type ReservationEventType = "reservation:created" | "reservation:updated" | "reservation:cancelled" | "hold:created" | "hold:released" | "hold:confirmed" | "table:updated"

## Services

### venueGroupService (src/services/venue.ts)
- list(page, limit): PaginatedResponse<VenueGroup>
- getById(id): VenueGroup | null
- getBySlug(slug): VenueGroup | null
- create(data: CreateVenueGroupRequest): VenueGroup
- update(id, data: UpdateVenueGroupRequest): VenueGroup | null
- delete(id): boolean

### venueService (src/services/venue.ts)
- list(page, limit, venueGroupId?): PaginatedResponse<Venue>
- getById(id): Venue | null
- getBySlug(slug, venueGroupId?): Venue | null
- create(data: CreateVenueRequest): Venue
- update(id, data: UpdateVenueRequest): Venue | null
- delete(id): boolean

### tableService (src/services/table.ts)
- list(page, limit, activeOnly?): PaginatedResponse<Table>
- getById(id): Table | null
- create(data: CreateTableRequest): Table
- update(id, data: UpdateTableRequest): Table | null
- updateStatus(id, status): Table | null
- delete(id): boolean

### reservationService (src/services/reservation.ts)
- list(options: ListReservationsOptions): PaginatedResponse<Reservation>
- listByUserId(userId, page, limit): PaginatedResponse<Reservation>
- getById(id): Reservation | null
- create(data: CreateReservationRequest, userId?): Reservation
- createWithConflictCheck(data, userId?): CreateReservationResult
- update(id, data: UpdateReservationRequest): Reservation | null
- updateWithConflictCheck(id, data): UpdateReservationResult
- createWalkIn(data: WalkInRequest, userId?): CreateReservationResult
- cancel(id, reason?, note?): Reservation | null

### holdService (src/services/hold.ts)
- create(data: CreateHoldRequest, sessionId): CreateHoldResult
- getById(id): ReservationHold | null
- getBySessionId(sessionId, venueId): ReservationHold | null
- release(id, sessionId): boolean
- convertToReservation(holdId, sessionId, guestDetails, userId?): ConfirmHoldResult
- cleanupExpired(): number
- maybeCleanup(): boolean

### guestService (src/services/guest.ts)
- list(venueId, page, limit): PaginatedResponse<Guest>
- getById(id): Guest | null
- findByEmail(venueId, email): Guest | null
- findByPhone(venueId, phone): Guest | null
- findOrCreate(venueId, data): Guest
- create(data: CreateGuestRequest): Guest
- update(id, data: UpdateGuestRequest): Guest | null
- delete(id): boolean
- recordVisit(guestId, visitDate, spendAmount?): Guest | null
- search(params: GuestSearchParams): PaginatedResponse<Guest>
- getSegments(venueId): GuestSegment[]

### floorPlanService (src/services/floor-plan.ts)
- list(page, limit, venueId?): PaginatedResponse<FloorPlan>
- getById(id): FloorPlan | null
- getActiveByVenueId(venueId): FloorPlan | null
- create(data: CreateFloorPlanRequest): FloorPlan
- update(id, data: UpdateFloorPlanRequest): FloorPlan | null
- delete(id): boolean
- setActive(id, venueId): FloorPlan | null
- updateTablePosition(tableId, shapeMetadata): Table | null
- bulkUpdateTablePositions(floorPlanId, positions): Table[]
- assignTableToFloorPlan(tableId, floorPlanId, shapeMetadata?): Table | null
- removeTableFromFloorPlan(tableId): Table | null

### availabilityService (src/services/availability.ts)
- generateTimeSlots(venueId, date, partySize, durationOverride?): TimeSlot[]
- getAvailableDates(venueId, startDate, endDate, partySize): DateAvailability[]
- findBestTable(venueId, date, startTime, endTime, partySize): Table | null
- checkConflict(tableId, date, startTime, endTime, excludeReservationId?, excludeHoldId?): ConflictCheckResult
- checkPacing(venueId, startTime, partySize, settings?): PacingCheckResult
- estimateDuration(partySize, venueSettings?): number

### reservationEvents (src/services/events.ts)
- emitReservationCreated(reservation): void
- emitReservationUpdated(reservation): void
- emitReservationCancelled(reservation): void
- emitHoldCreated(hold): void
- emitHoldReleased(hold): void
- emitHoldConfirmed(reservation): void
- emitTableUpdated(table): void

### database (src/services/database.ts)
- prisma: PrismaClient
- getSlowQueryStats(): { count5min, slowestMs }
- getServiceStatus(): "ok" | "degraded"

## Routes

### Venues: src/routes/venues.ts
GET /api/v1/venues, GET /api/v1/venues/:id, POST /api/v1/venues, PUT /api/v1/venues/:id

### Tables: src/routes/tables.ts
GET /api/v1/tables, POST /api/v1/tables, PUT /api/v1/tables/:id, PUT /api/v1/tables/:id/status, DELETE /api/v1/tables/:id

### Reservations: src/routes/reservations.ts
GET /api/v1/reservations, GET /api/v1/reservations/:id, POST /api/v1/reservations, PUT /api/v1/reservations/:id, PUT /api/v1/reservations/:id/cancel

### Holds: src/routes/holds.ts
POST /api/v1/holds, GET /api/v1/holds/:id, PUT /api/v1/holds/:id/confirm, DELETE /api/v1/holds/:id

### Guests: src/routes/guests.ts
Full CRUD + search + segments

### Floor Plans: src/routes/floor-plans.ts
Full CRUD + setActive + table positioning

### Availability: src/routes/availability.ts
GET /api/v1/availability (time slots), GET /api/v1/availability/dates (date range)

### Events: src/routes/events.ts
GET /api/v1/events/stream (SSE)

### Health: src/routes/health.ts
GET /health

## App Entry

src/app.ts: buildApp(options?: AppOptions): FastifyInstance
src/index.ts: main() — starts server
